High: coherent columns and row rhythm, differentiated invite action, active navigation and search outline/caret. Secondary metadata subdued. Only search focus is visible.

High within crop: strong heading, concise explanation and spacious action group. Provider colors compete equally for attention; right/left button groups leave a broad gap. No navigation/focus evidence.
High within crop: address/status/action hierarchy, text-labeled status chips and red destructive menu item. Menu anchored near overflow; footer distinct. Open menu does not establish keyboard focus.
